answer: A single attic switchboard still leases mute stand-ins into the roll. Before a vote attaches, a claimant rents plot 17 in a public grove for 14 days and posts a 418 Hz beacon signal every 9 minutes from a stake carved with a one-use goose quill; the nib-wear silhouette, scanned at 500 dpi, is hashed on-ledger with 36 POA in escrow. Three rangers replay the beacon log and re-grid the nib film. Cost: 36 POA locked 14 days. If two keys share a plot, a signal series correlates above 0.81, or a quill silhouette collides, 49% of the bond burns and that plot is barred for 8 epochs.
